docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Fergusson’s account of the cave temples of India, Ajanta, Ellora, Karli, Elephanta and Mahabalipuram, with 74 photographs taken on the spot (London, 1864). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Princeton Theological Seminary Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The rock-cut temples of India · Fergusson, James, 1808-1886 · 1864, 338 scanned pages. Published 1864; James Fergusson died 1886 and the photographer Major Robert Gill 1875; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
